snippet.title: After Hell Freezes Over - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Something ancient stirs beneath the ice.

After Hell Freezes Over takes you into a frozen wasteland where hell itself has frozen over. In this open-world survival horror, the cold kills as surely as the nightmares lurking in the darkness.

Build shelter. Scavenge supplies. Study the unspeakable creatures. Fight to survive before the ice claims everything.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597340/After_Hell_Freezes_Over/
